items.title_orig: Songs that feel like it'll all be over soon
items.article_text:
I had a dream of the end of the world. 
 What songs capture hopeless resignation and embracing the tides of something much bigger than yourself. 
 I'll start with the obligatory Where is My Mind by The Pixies and Release by Pearl Jam.
    submitted by    /u/BruceLeeKillerBee    to    r/SongsThatFeelLikeThis
